fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe tener una fecha de vencimiento al menos 3 meses posterior al día en que planeas salir del espacio Schengen.
entry.quote: have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area

entry.en: Your passport must have a date of issue less than 10 years before the date you arrive.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe tener una fecha de expedición de menos de 10 años antes de tu llegada.
entry.quote: have a ‘date of issue’ less than 10 years before the date you arrive

entry.en: When entering the Schengen area for short stays, you may need to register biometric details such as fingerprints and a photo.
entry.es: Al entrar en el espacio Schengen para estancias cortas, puede que debas registrar datos biométricos como huellas dactilares y una foto.
entry.quote: you may need to register your biometric details, such as fingerprints and a photo.

entry.en: At Norwegian border control you may need to show proof of your accommodation, such as a hotel booking confirmation.
entry.es: En el control fronterizo noruego puede que debas mostrar un comprobante de alojamiento, como una confirmación de reserva de hotel.
entry.quote: show proof of your accommodation, for example, a hotel booking confirmation or proof of address for a second home

entry.en: You must declare cash or travellers cheques worth 25,000 Norwegian krone or more.
entry.es: Debes declarar efectivo o cheques de viaje por valor de 25.000 coronas noruegas o más.
entry.quote: Declare cash or travellers cheques if the value is 25,000 Norwegian krone or more.

entry.en: You cannot take meat, milk or products containing them into EEA countries without special permission.
entry.es: No se puede llevar carne, leche ni productos que las contengan a países del EEE sin permiso especial.
entry.quote: You cannot take meat, milk or products containing them into EEA countries without special permission.

safety.en: There is a small risk of petty theft, particularly at airports and railway stations in and around Oslo.
safety.es: Existe un riesgo pequeño de hurtos, sobre todo en aeropuertos y estaciones de tren de Oslo y alrededores.
safety.quote: There’s a small risk of petty theft, particularly at airports and railway stations in and around Oslo.

safety.en: Terrorist attacks in Norway cannot be ruled out.
safety.es: No se pueden descartar atentados terroristas en Noruega.
safety.quote: Terrorist attacks in Norway cannot be ruled out.

safety.en: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, carry severe penalties.
safety.es: Las drogas ilegales, incluido el cannabis, conllevan penas severas.
safety.quote: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, carry severe penalties.

safety.en: Drink-driving is a serious offence in Norway.
safety.es: Conducir bajo los efectos del alcohol es un delito grave en Noruega.
safety.quote: Drink-driving is a serious offence in Norway.

safety.en: Weather can change quickly, producing Arctic conditions even in summer on exposed mountain tops.
safety.es: El tiempo puede cambiar rápidamente y crear condiciones árticas incluso en verano en las cumbres expuestas.
safety.quote: The weather can change quickly, producing Arctic conditions even in summer on exposed mountain tops.

safety.en: In Svalbard, follow the safety advice of the Governor of Svalbard, including on protecting yourself from polar bear attacks.
safety.es: En Svalbard, sigue los consejos de seguridad del gobernador de Svalbard, incluida la protección frente a ataques de osos polares.
safety.quote: Follow the safety advice of the Governor of Svalbard, including on how to protect yourself from polar bear attacks

health.en: Tap water is always drinkable, except on boats, trains and similar, and there is generally no need to buy bottled water.
health.es: El agua del grifo siempre es potable, salvo en barcos, trenes y similares, y por lo general no hace falta comprar agua embotellada.
health.quote: Tap water is always drinkable (except on boats, trains etc.) and there is generally no need to buy bottled water

health.en: In southern Norway there are ticks in summer, which can transmit Lyme disease or tick-borne encephalitis through a bite.
health.es: En el sur de Noruega hay garrapatas en verano, que pueden transmitir la enfermedad de Lyme o la encefalitis transmitida por garrapatas.
health.quote: In southern Norway, there are ticks (flått) in summer. They can transmit Lyme disease (borreliosis) or TBE (tick-borne encephalitis) through a bite.

health.en: Check that you have appropriate travel insurance for local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation.
health.es: Comprueba que tienes un seguro de viaje adecuado para tratamiento local o una evacuación médica imprevista.
health.quote: you have appropriate travel insurance for local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation

health.en: Norway has a high density of pharmacies.
health.es: Noruega tiene una alta densidad de farmacias.
health.quote: Norway has a high density of pharmacies.

help.en: The emergency numbers in Norway are 110 for fire, 112 for police and 113 for ambulance.
help.es: Los números de emergencia en Noruega son 110 para bomberos, 112 para policía y 113 para ambulancia.

getting_in.en: Oslo Airport, Gardermoen is the biggest airport in Norway and the main international hub, about 60 km north of Oslo.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Oslo-Gardermoen es el mayor de Noruega y el principal centro internacional, a unos 60 km al norte de Oslo.
getting_in.quote: Oslo Airport, Gardermoen (OSL IATA) is the biggest airport in Norway and the main international hub, at Gardermoen 60 km (37 mi) north of Oslo.

getting_in.en: Because Norway is not in the EU, arrivals by plane may be subject to customs controls at the port of entry.
getting_in.es: Como Noruega no pertenece a la UE, los llegados en avión pueden pasar controles de aduana en el punto de entrada.
getting_in.quote: Norway is not a member of the European Union. This means that you, especially if arriving by plane, regardless of point of origin, may be subject to customs controls at the port of entry.

getting_in.en: Operators may carry out identity checks before passengers board international flights, ferries or trains, even between Schengen countries.
getting_in.es: Los operadores pueden hacer controles de identidad antes de embarcar en vuelos, ferris o trenes internacionales, incluso entre países Schengen.
getting_in.quote: The operators may carry out identity checks before passengers board international flights, ferries or trains, even between Schengen countries.

getting_in.en: There are trains from Sweden to Oslo, Trondheim and Narvik, but no railways across the border from Finland and Russia.
getting_in.es: Hay trenes desde Suecia a Oslo, Trondheim y Narvik, pero no hay ferrocarriles que crucen la frontera desde Finlandia y Rusia.
getting_in.quote: There are trains from Sweden to Oslo, Trondheim and Narvik, with onwards inland connections. There are no railways across the border from Finland and Russia.

getting_in.en: It is possible to enter Norway by road from Sweden, Finland or Russia.
getting_in.es: Es posible entrar a Noruega por carretera desde Suecia, Finlandia o Rusia.
getting_in.quote: It is possible to enter by road from Sweden, Finland, or Russia.

getting_around.en: For public transportation (trains, buses and ferries), the online travel planner Entur is the one to use.
getting_around.es: Para el transporte público (trenes, autobuses y ferris) se usa el planificador de viajes en línea Entur.
getting_around.quote: For public transportation (trains, buses and ferries), use the online travel planner Entur.

getting_around.en: For long-distance and night trains, seat reservation is mandatory but can usually be done on short notice.
getting_around.es: En los trenes de larga distancia y nocturnos la reserva de asiento es obligatoria, pero normalmente se puede hacer con poca antelación.
getting_around.quote: For long-distance trains and night trains, seat reservation is mandatory, but usually can be done on short notice

getting_around.en: Norway has no high-speed rail except between Oslo and its airport, so Bergen to Oslo takes 6½–7½ hours.
getting_around.es: Noruega no tiene tren de alta velocidad salvo entre Oslo y su aeropuerto, así que de Bergen a Oslo se tardan 6½–7½ horas.
getting_around.quote: Norway does not have a high-speed rail system, except for the route between Oslo and its airport.

getting_around.en: Car ferries are an integral part of the road network in coastal and fjord regions.
getting_around.es: Los ferris de coches forman parte integral de la red viaria en las zonas costeras y de fiordos.
getting_around.quote: Car ferries are an integral part of the road network in coastal and fjord regions.

getting_around.en: On main roads, car ferries are frequent during the daytime, typically every half hour, and reservations are usually not needed.
getting_around.es: En las carreteras principales los ferris son frecuentes de día, normalmente cada media hora, y por lo general no hace falta reservar.
getting_around.quote: On the main roads ferries are frequent during daytime, typically every half hour. Reservations are usually not needed

getting_around.en: Domestic flights are a convenient option because the craggy coastline and mountainous terrain slow down overland traffic.
getting_around.es: Los vuelos nacionales son una opción cómoda porque la costa escarpada y el terreno montañoso ralentizan el tráfico terrestre.
getting_around.quote: As Norway's craggy coastline and mountainous terrain slow down overland traffic, domestic flights are a convenient option.

money.en: The Norwegian currency is the krone (NOK).
money.es: La moneda noruega es la corona (NOK).
money.quote: Norwegian currency is the Norwegian krone (crown, plural: kroner) (ISO code: NOK)

money.en: Virtually all stores accept major credit cards such as MasterCard and Visa.
money.es: Prácticamente todas las tiendas aceptan las principales tarjetas de crédito, como MasterCard y Visa.
money.quote: Virtually all stores accept major credit cards such as MasterCard and Visa.

money.en: Euros are generally not accepted in shops, except in some airports, international transport and a small number of tourist-oriented businesses.
money.es: Los euros por lo general no se aceptan en las tiendas, salvo en algunos aeropuertos, el transporte internacional y unos pocos negocios turísticos.
money.quote: Euros are generally not accepted in shops, except in some airports, international transport (flights, ferries), and a small number of business targeting tourists.

money.en: Manned exchange offices usually apply a substantial markup, so withdrawing local cash from ATMs is the best option.
money.es: Las oficinas de cambio con personal suelen aplicar un recargo considerable, así que lo mejor es sacar efectivo local en cajeros.
money.quote: Thus your best option is to withdraw the local cash you need from ATMs.

money.en: If asked to choose between Norwegian kroner and your card's home currency, select Norwegian kroner.
money.es: Si te piden elegir entre coronas noruegas y la moneda de tu tarjeta, elige coronas noruegas.

money.en: Norway is an expensive country for visitors, and anything seen as a service will generally cost more than you expect.
money.es: Noruega es un país caro para los visitantes, y todo lo que se considere un servicio suele costar más de lo esperado.
money.quote: Norway is an expensive country for visitors.

etiquette.en: Behaving as if either party is inferior or superior is considered exceptionally rude in Norway.
etiquette.es: Comportarse como si una de las partes fuera inferior o superior se considera extremadamente grosero en Noruega.
etiquette.quote: Behaving in a way that suggests either party is inferior or superior is considered exceptionally rude

etiquette.en: Norwegians can be very direct and generally avoid small talk, which is a matter of culture.
etiquette.es: Los noruegos pueden ser muy directos y en general evitan la charla trivial, lo cual es cuestión de cultura.
etiquette.quote: they can be very direct and that small talk is generally avoided.

etiquette.en: Expressing thanks is important in Norway and happens in many situations.
etiquette.es: Dar las gracias es importante en Noruega y se hace en muchas situaciones.
etiquette.quote: expressing thanks is important in Norway, this occurs in many situations.

etiquette.en: A firm but brief handshake is the standard greeting.
etiquette.es: Un apretón de manos firme pero breve es el saludo habitual.
etiquette.quote: A firm but brief handshake is the standard style of greeting

etiquette.en: It is customary to take off your shoes when entering a Norwegian home.
etiquette.es: Es costumbre quitarse los zapatos al entrar en una casa noruega.
etiquette.quote: It is customary to take off your shoes when entering a Norwegian home

etiquette.en: Showing up late for meetings is considered rude in Norway.
etiquette.es: Llegar tarde a las reuniones se considera de mala educación en Noruega.
etiquette.quote: showing up late for meetings is considered rude

connectivity.en: Mobile phone coverage is universal in urban areas and generally good in rural Norway.
connectivity.es: La cobertura móvil es universal en zonas urbanas y por lo general buena en zonas rurales de Noruega.
connectivity.quote: Mobile phone coverage is universal in urban areas and generally also good in rural Norway

connectivity.en: If you come from another EU or EEA country, you will likely be able to keep using your SIM without surcharges, subject to fair-use limits.
connectivity.es: Si vienes de otro país de la UE o del EEE, probablemente podrás seguir usando tu SIM sin recargos, sujeto a límites de uso razonable.
connectivity.quote: you will likely be able to continue using your SIM in Norway without surcharges, subject to any fair-use limits imposed by your provider.

connectivity.en: Telenor sells a prepaid SIM for 49 kr in convenience stores.
connectivity.es: Telenor vende una SIM de prepago por 49 kr en tiendas de conveniencia.
connectivity.quote: however you can purchase it in convenience stores for 49 kr.

connectivity.en: Telia offers prepaid starter packs for 99 kr including nationwide calls and texts and 250MB of data valid for 14 days.
connectivity.es: Telia ofrece paquetes de prepago por 99 kr con llamadas y SMS nacionales y 250 MB de datos válidos durante 14 días.
connectivity.quote: They offer starter packs for 99 kr, including nationwide calls and texts as well as 250MB data valid for 14 days.

connectivity.en: Wireless internet zones can be found just about everywhere, but you should be prepared to pay for it.
connectivity.es: Hay zonas de internet inalámbrico prácticamente en todas partes, pero hay que estar preparado para pagar.
connectivity.quote: you will find wireless internet zones just about everywhere
